users_quiet_hours_range.name: users_quiet_hours_range
users_quiet_hours_range.value:
("users"."quiet_hours_start" IS NULL OR "users"."quiet_hours_start" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)
      AND ("users"."quiet_hours_end" IS NULL OR "users"."quiet_hours_end" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)
      AND (("users"."quiet_hours_start" IS NULL) = ("users"."quiet_hours_end" IS NULL))

events_pricing_mode_consistent.name: events_pricing_mode_consistent
events_pricing_mode_consistent.value: ("events"."price_mode" = 'fixed' AND "events"."target_amount" IS NULL AND "events"."pricing_settled_at" IS NULL AND "events"."pricing_participant_count" IS NULL) OR ("events"."price_mode" = 'split' AND "events"."price" = 0 AND "events"."target_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."target_amount" > 0)

events_pricing_settlement_pair.name: events_pricing_settlement_pair
events_pricing_settlement_pair.value: ("events"."pricing_settled_at" IS NULL AND "events"."pricing_participant_count" IS NULL) OR ("events"."pricing_settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."pricing_participant_count" IS NOT NULL AND "events"."pricing_participant_count" > 0)

events_series_date_required.name: events_series_date_required
events_series_date_required.value: "events"."series_id" IS NULL OR "events"."series_date" IS NOT NULL

payments_booking_incarnation_required.name: payments_booking_incarnation_required
payments_booking_incarnation_required.value: "payments"."booking_id" IS NULL OR "payments"."booking_incarnation" IS NOT NULL

event_balance_entries_delta_sign.name: event_balance_entries_delta_sign
event_balance_entries_delta_sign.value: ("event_balance_entries"."reason" = 'spend' AND "event_balance_entries"."delta" < 0) OR "event_balance_entries"."reason" = 'correction' OR ("event_balance_entries"."reason" NOT IN ('spend', 'correction') AND "event_balance_entries"."delta" > 0)

event_balance_entries_comment_required.name: event_balance_entries_comment_required
event_balance_entries_comment_required.value: ("event_balance_entries"."actor_kind" <> 'system' AND "event_balance_entries"."reason" NOT IN ('grant', 'correction')) OR "event_balance_entries"."comment" IS NOT NULL
